kinds.d: A rod fixed above a window or door from which curtains hang on rings or by their heading.
A fixed track with runners or gliders along which curtains are drawn.

kinds.a: curtain rings · curtain hooks · tieback · holdback
kinds.d: Small hardware that attaches a curtain to its pole or track or holds it back when drawn.

notes: Five old kinds merged into three: pole bracket/finial into Curtain pole as types; rings and hooks plus tiebacks into Curtain fittings with rings, hooks, gliders, clips, tiebacks and holdbacks as types. Old sources kept; old IKEA FRAMFUSIG/VIDGA entries kept.
